characters.description: A daughter of Athena and a veteran Greek demigod, sharp, proud, and a gifted architect and strategist. After months of searching she is about to be reunited with her missing boyfriend, Percy Jackson, as the Greek warship carries her to the Roman camp. Level-headed under pressure, she leads with logic and planning, but she also carries a private task from her mother that she must undertake alone, a dangerous inheritance that troubles the children of Athena.
characters.name: Annabeth Chase

characters.description: A son of the sea god and hero of the earlier Percy Jackson stories, his memory now fully restored. Having spent the previous book among the Roman demigods, he is a made praetor of their legion, but his heart belongs to the Greek camp and to Annabeth. Brave, loyal, and powerful over water, he serves as a bridge between the two camps even as their old mistrust threatens to boil over.
characters.name: Percy Jackson

characters.description: A son of the sky god and a former praetor of the Roman camp, disciplined and steady, with power over wind and lightning. Having recovered his memory in the previous book, he now stands between two worlds, trusted by the Romans yet committed to the joint quest with the Greeks. He tries to keep the fragile alliance together while wrestling with where he truly belongs.
characters.name: Jason Grace

characters.description: A daughter of Aphrodite whose persuasive charmspeak can sway others with her voice. Practical and brave, she has grown into her powers and into her place among the demigods since discovering her heritage. Loyal to Jason and to her friends, she uses her gift and her level head to defuse danger, though she is unsettled by ominous visions of what may lie ahead on the voyage.
characters.name: Piper McLean

characters.description: A son of Hephaestus, inventive and quick with a joke, who built and now captains the flying warship Argo II. Able to summon and control fire, he keeps the vessel running and improvises machines for every crisis. His humor masks a lingering loneliness, and he feels the odd one out as the only member of the crew without a partner.
characters.name: Leo Valdez

characters.description: A daughter of Pluto from the Roman camp who can call precious metals and jewels from the earth. Gentle and brave, she has come to terms with a past that once haunted her and joins the joint quest as one of the seven. She is close to Frank and to Nico, and her underworld heritage gives her insight into dangers the others cannot sense.
characters.name: Hazel Levesque

characters.description: A son of Mars from the Roman camp, a strong archer with a rare gift for changing his shape into animals. Loyal and increasingly confident since proving himself, he guards a secret weakness: his life is tied to a fragile piece of wood. Devoted to Hazel and to his duty, he brings steady courage to the crew.
characters.name: Frank Zhang

characters.description: A praetor of the Roman camp and daughter of a war goddess, disciplined, proud, and protective of her legion. She receives the Greek warship and its crew warily, hoping the two camps can find peace but braced for betrayal. Burdened by the responsibility of leadership, she must decide how far to trust the Greeks she has been raised to distrust.
characters.name: Reyna

characters.description: A brooding son of the underworld god who commands the dead and travels through shadows, known from the earlier stories. Solitary and secretive, he moves between the Greek and Roman worlds and knows more of the underworld's secrets than he shares. His whereabouts become a matter of urgency as the quest turns toward the ancient lands.
characters.name: Nico di Angelo

characters.description: The gruff, club-swinging satyr who serves as the crew's adult chaperone aboard the Argo II. Hot-tempered and always spoiling for a fight, he takes his protective duties seriously beneath the bluster, guarding the young demigods and enforcing a semblance of discipline on the voyage.
characters.name: Gleeson Hedge

characters.description: The primordial earth goddess, the sleeping enemy behind the demigods' peril. Speaking through dreams and the ground itself, she works to wake her monstrous children, the giants, and to spill enough demigod blood to rouse herself fully. Her servants harry the crew across sea and land as she draws nearer to waking in the ancient heart of the old world.
characters.name: Gaea
